events.title: Djibouti faces ‘overlapping emergencies’ as Yemen’s refugee exodus continues
events.description: Djibouti is facing “overlapping emergencies” as refugees fleeing the conflict in Yemen arrive on its shores while migrants continue to travel in the opposite direction, the UN migration agency (IOM) warned on Tuesday.
